notes: STATIC backend graph. The UI draws it and highlights it with trace.hop events.
A hop is drawn along the edge connecting from and to, regardless of direction.
layer suggests a column from left to right (0 to 4). The UI decides the final layout.
Component IDs are open strings: more can be added (such as chess) without changing the types.
contribution is optional: the owner can add a contribution per component. When null, it is omitted.
flows is only for the legend and documentation; the actual animation comes from trace.hop.

components.label: Your browser
components.what: Where you are now: the interface you see, ask questions from and use to send messages.

components.label: Traefik
components.what: The entrance. Receives all traffic, secures it with HTTPS and routes it to the correct service.

components.label: Gateway
components.what: Identifies the visitor, limits usage and pushes everything that happens to your browser in real time.

components.label: Redis
components.what: Instant messaging between services and fast session memory.

components.label: Agent
components.what: Decides where to take you, finds information and designs new nodes when needed.

components.label: n8n
components.what: Runs long workflows step by step, such as creating a node or notifying me of your message, while you watch it work.

components.label: Language model
components.what: The AI that understands questions and writes answers. It sits behind an interface so it can be replaced.

components.label: Postgres + pgvector
components.what: Stores generated nodes and chat messages, and enables semantic search using vectors.

components.label: My phone
components.what: Where live chat messages reach me. I reply from there and my response appears on your screen.

flows.label: Question with an existing node
flows.description: The agent understands the question and takes you to an existing node. It does not go through n8n.

flows.label: Question requiring a new node
flows.description: There is no node: the agent starts an n8n workflow that searches the knowledge base, designs the node and saves it.

flows.label: Your message reaches my phone
flows.description: The gateway saves your message and n8n forwards it to me.

flows.label: My reply reaches your screen
flows.description: I reply from my phone; n8n saves it and the gateway pushes it to you over the WebSocket.
